title: Discrete Varying Delay
text: 支持固定延迟和零延迟（直接馈通）的离散可变延迟，输入 2 路、输出 1 路；按 {Initial output} 指定初始输出；{Nominal delay (number of samples)} 指定延迟的标称值、{Maximum delay} 指定延迟长度输入的最大值、{Fixed delays (indices)} 指定具有固定延迟的信号索引、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定采样时间、{Prevent direct feedthrough with minimum delay of 1} 防止直接馈通，按实例取值。

ports.name: u
ports.summary: 数据输入信号 scalar | vector

params.name: Nominal delay (number of samples)
params.values: 延迟的标称值 1 (default) | nonnegative integer | vector of nonnegative integer values

params.name: Maximum delay
params.values: 延迟长度输入的最大值 10 (default) | nonnegative integer | vector of nonnegative integer values

params.name: Fixed delays (indices)
params.values: 具有固定延迟的信号索引 [] (default) | positive scalar | vector of positive values

params.name: Prevent direct feedthrough with minimum delay of 1
params.values: 防止直接馈通 off (default) | on
